title: Pure Mist Cola 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Cola delivers the unmistakable taste of a classic Cola drink, complete with a sweet, fizzy taste. This smooth and refreshing e-liquid captures the nostalgic flavour of your favourite soda, making it a great choice for fans of sweet and sparkling blends. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers a variety of VG/PG ratios to cater to different preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more pronounced flavour with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Cola provides a flavour-packed option for adult vapers. Made in the UK with premium ingredients, this e-liquid delivers consistent quality and satisfaction.
